_comment: Keys are '<agent>|<intent>'. A bare '<agent>' key applies to every intent. Intents come from the orchestrator contract: Full Triage, Normalization Only, Classification Only, Enrichment, Resolved Ticket Review, Information Request, Write Request, Explanation, Detail Expansion. Matching is in-order-with-extras: every step below must appear in this order, extras are allowed and counted against precision. Author these from a run a reviewer approved: take the 'trajectory' column in runs_summary.csv and strip the wasted steps. Keep them MINIMAL — each entry should be a step whose absence is a real defect, not a step that merely happened.
_provenance: Authored 2026-09-16 from the two orchestrations in traces/2026-09-03-full-triage.csv. These are baseline placeholders, not reviewer-approved ground truth: no human has confirmed these runs were correct. Replace them from Dataverse AI Review once approved runs are accumulating — an 'approved, no override' review is a gold trajectory by definition.
